title: Cr0c's Plushies!
description: Many plushies to the game, to make the game feel a little more cozy!
body:
Ever wanted some cozy additions for minecraft? Well, we got the thing for you... PLUSHIES!

I (Cr0c), aim to add mainly plushies, but also some other cozy things to the game, like boba!

So enjoy your plushies, and stay comfy!

(this mod was made within the limitations of MCreator)
